reviews.title: Perfect cpu temps at unbeatable price
reviews.comment: For the price the cooler is a fantastic value and it works great. I have mine configured with both fans and during stress testing the cpu never went over 76c. Idle temps sit between 33-45. Mounting wasn't too difficult, but you do need access to both sides of your motherboard. I didn't need to remove my mobo, I just needed to open the other side of the case. The airflow on the fans are adequate. My hardware monitoring puts the max speed of the fans around 2k rpm. Personally, I will replace the fans just because I like faster fans but the ones that came with it seem good enough.
reviews.author: Dan

reviews.title: It cools very well, and it is quiet.
reviews.comment: This dual-tower CPU cooler completely exceeded my expectations. The build quality is excellent, with its six copper heat pipes that truly help dissipate heat quickly and efficiently. Since installing it, my processor stays much cooler even under heavy load , which makes a noticeable difference in performance.
reviews.author: Blanca Gutierrez

reviews.title: Big beefy boi of a cooler with amazing cooling ability and remaining quiet when under load
reviews.comment: Amazing cooler for the price. It keeps the cpu on my lga1150 intel i74770k cooler than the stock fan and is super quiet while also being RGB if I want to use that. Installation is super simple and it comes with thermal paste that works well out of the box. Would definitely suggest for a budget cooler if it fits your socket type. Just one word of caution is that this cooler is beefy and might not fit in some tower cases, so make sure you check max clearance between the cpu/processor and side of case.
reviews.author: Cody

reviews.title: Good budget option
reviews.comment:
Good budget option, keeps my R5 3600 around 60 deg while gaming.
Its a bit on the noisy side, rpms are 2000 +/- 10%
Argb controller is not included, either your mobo has the argb header or you have an external argb contoller.
Would buy again.
reviews.author: Vladimir dominguez

reviews.title: Good, nice, and cheap
reviews.comment: It works well, and it's affordable and looks nice. I haven't seen the temperatures go above 60 while gaming. I recommend it, the RGB works with a Corsair Commander Duo.
reviews.author: Jose Angel Gutierrez
